limitations: Small unreviewed agent-authored synthetic smoke corpus, no independent, held-out or representative accuracy claim.
Offline controls are hand-authored good/bad outputs; their pass rate measures the scorer and admission paths, never Gemini quality.
Chat intent means production typed navigation/checkup fields; there is no separate semantic-intent classifier in this run.
Currency-marker amounts, exact reference membership and narrow required/forbidden phrase patterns are scored. Bare numbers, attribution swaps and unrestricted prose semantics are not fully verified.
Missing-citation checks measure expected references, not whether a valid reference semantically supports every sentence. No judge model supplies truth.
Abstention is a predeclared literal-phrase diagnostic because production ChatAnswer has no abstention field; paraphrases can be missed.
Extraction uses two tiny text PDFs; OCR, scanned images, complex layouts and real institution format coverage remain unmeasured.
Production chat may repair once; every SDK invocation consumes the same hard cap. Provider retries are disabled for opt-in live runs.
A configured model name hash identifies requested configuration, not immutable provider weights. Response model version is recorded when supplied.

change_log.reason: Absence of a repeated disclaimer is not an affirmative fraud or completion claim.

change_log.change: Distinguish original recorded production admission and source hashes from re-admission under current runtime sources. Hash checkup, narration, refund and model-amount formatting modules and report narration VERSION.
change_log.reason: Runtime changes can affect derived context, opaque finding IDs and admission independently of a scoring revision.

limitations: Protocol v2 was authored after inspecting the v1 live results and cannot substantiate an unseen or independent performance improvement.
Input facts are separate static rules, checked against source rows; no model output supplies an expected amount or label.
Source-supported monetary values are not sufficient proof of role, date, causal or merchant attribution. Only the explicitly checked roles and months receive additional finite checks.
Finite English paraphrase and contradiction patterns cannot certify unrestricted free prose. Bare numeric claims and unrecognised constructions remain outside verified coverage.
Original and current runtime admission can differ after implementation changes; any such difference is reported separately from scoring changes.

score_definitions.abstentions: Extraction complete=false or a pre-authored chat abstention phrase. Schema/provider failures are separate rejected/unresolved outputs.
score_definitions.hash_encoding: SHA256 of UTF-8 compact sorted JSON for structured values; raw file bytes for fixture/source files; raw UTF-8 strings for contents/response text.
score_definitions.incorrect_amounts: Extraction: row positions with a wrong debit/credit pair, plus parse errors. Chat: distinct currency-marked values outside that case's pre-authored allowed amounts. Task counts have different units and are also shown separately.
score_definitions.invalid_references: Unknown extraction source-unit IDs or chat evidence IDs outside the pre-authored case allowlist.
score_definitions.missing_literal_claim_checks: Number of pre-authored required factual phrase patterns absent; paraphrases may be missed.
score_definitions.passed: Production admission AND static raw expectations, plus exact normalized extraction rows/source checks where applicable.
score_definitions.unsupported_known_claims: Number of matching pre-authored forbidden factual/action phrase patterns; not all unsupported prose.
